name: Debug (S3)
description: Saves every event of the agent's runs as a JSON file in an S3 bucket, to inspect what goes in and out of them. The files hold whole conversations: add it only while debugging. The credentials need s3:ListBucket on the bucket, for the health check's HeadBucket, and s3:PutObject on its objects, to save the files.
